verdict.rationale: Shopify Markets is documented for selling to multiple markets from a single store. Merchants can tailor the store by region, manage all markets in one place, and use "View as" previews to confirm customers in each market see the right products and pricing. That covers localized storefronts and implies per-market pricing. The pack never explicitly mentions multi-currency, translations, or duties, and the tax evidence covers only US sales tax. Missing for 10: explicit multi-currency conversion/pricing evidence, translation/localization of content, duties and import tax handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
